titles.romaji: Mouse Cursor de Genjitsu wo Sousa Dekiru You ni Natta node, Onnanoko wo Ippai Click Shimasu
titles.english: Now That I Can Control Reality With A Mouse Cursor, I'm Gonna Click Away On The Girls!
titles.native: マウスカーソルで現実を操作できるようになったので、女の子をいっぱいクリックしまーす

description:
What if you could control reality with a mouse cursor?

One day during class, Takumi— an otaku — notices his mouse cursor has sprung out of the screen.

Panicked, he asks his childhood friend Mone, sitting next to him, to take a look, only to be brushed off...

Once Takumi realizes he could actually control it himself, he uses the mouse cursor— visible only to him— to slip it in between Mone's clothes and starts clicking away...

Here's Japan’s (probably) first new genre of romcom, "Clicking Away at a Gyaru Who's Mean to Otakus with a Mouse Cursor"!

(Source: Official Site)

Note: Episode 1 receives an advanced distribution on AnimeFesta on September 11th, 2026. The start date reflects the start of the regular series broadcasting.
